{{Quote|It was the moment of my life.|Canderous Ordo|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''Unidentified Mandalorian battle''' occurred during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. It was [[Canderous Ordo]]'s first battle, and so [[Gender/Legends|he]] was the first to take the 80 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] plunge into the atmosphere on his [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]]. He landed and destroyed several [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]]. He later recalled the battle to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] describing it as the "moment of my life".
